init.title: Power assumptions and local access
init.description:
The Estimated Power and Estimated Energy sensors are modelled, not measured. Set the power each load actually draws on your spa so the Energy dashboard reflects it.

Optionally, enter your spa's IP address to read its state directly over your local network, so changes show up without waiting on the cloud. Commands are still sent via the cloud. Give the spa a fixed address in your router first, or local control will stop working when the address changes. Leave blank to use the cloud only.
